reason.title: Protein a day
reason.note: Lifting goals: 1.6 to 2.2 g per kg a day (Morton 2018). At 83.5 kg that is 134 to 184 g; the tick is for days with at least 134 g.

meals.name: Breakfast
meals.text: Overnight oats with whey, made with milk or with a big spoon of Greek yogurt.

meals.name: Lunch
meals.text: Fish, chicken or lamb, 2 palms, with vegetables, a cupped hand or two of rice, bread or potatoes, and olive oil, nuts or avocado.
meals.tip: Cook double at dinner and box half for the next day’s lunch.

meals.name: Dinner
meals.text: The salad becomes a full meal: 2 palms of protein (chicken, fish, eggs, lentils or chickpeas, cottage cheese), 1 cupped hand of carbs, 2 thumbs of fat.

meals.name: Snacks
meals.text: The 2 glasses of milk, plus skyr or Greek yogurt, a handful of nuts with fruit, or a boiled egg or two.

groups.name: Protein
groups.what: Fish, chicken, lamb, eggs, lentils or chickpeas, cottage cheese

groups.name: Carbs
groups.what: Rice, bread or potatoes; whole grains for the fiber

first.name: Cook double at dinner
first.text: Box half for the next day’s lunch

quick.name: A tuna or chickpea wrap
quick.text: Tin, wrap, a handful of salad

pattern.name: Lamb
pattern.target: at most twice a week, lean cuts

patternAlso: Olive or canola oil over butter, nuts most days, little added sugar and salt.

steps.when: Waist flat for 4 weeks and the trend not falling
steps.then: One cupped hand of carbs less a day

steps.when: Losing faster than 1 % of body weight a week

adjust.looseDay: Protein first at the next meal and back to the template; never skip a meal to make up for it.
